name: sentiment-mern-integration
description: This package runs the React frontend, Node.js backend, and Python sentiment model service together.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.train:sentiment: cd sentiment-service && venv\Scripts\python.exe generate_augmented_data.py && venv\Scripts\python.exe train_model.py
scripts.dev: concurrently -n CLIENT,SERVER,SENTIMENT -c blue,green,magenta "npm run client" "npm run server" "npm run sentiment"
